visual.general_description: Three CT angiogram panels (axial, sagittal, coronal) of one patient with yellow arrows marking the right carotid artery findings.
visual.detailed_description: Three grayscale CT angiogram images side by side, labelled A, B and C. A is an axial neck slice with a yellow arrow at a dimly opacified round vessel beside the airway; B is a sagittal head slice with a yellow arrow at the skull base; C is a coronal neck and skull base slice with a yellow arrow lateral to the cervical spine. Each panel carries only its panel letter and a single yellow arrow; no scale, laterality marker or patient text is printed.

panels.general_description: Axial CT angiogram slice through the neck with a yellow arrow beside a dimly opacified round vessel.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial slice through the upper neck at the level of a cervical vertebra, with the dark airway in front of the vertebral body, a bright vertebra and surrounding neck soft tissue. Panel letter A is at the upper left. A yellow arrow at the upper left of the image points down and to the right toward a small round soft-tissue-gray structure lateral to the airway; the round structure at the corresponding position on the opposite side of the image is larger and noticeably brighter (more strongly opacified). Small bright dots lie beside the airway on both sides. No printed laterality marker, scale or patient text is visible.
